verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MU nsi y'abagenyi,
Gye wagenda ggwe,
Wulira-eddoboozi
-Enkuyita:

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Komaw(o) omutambuze
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Enjala-ey'omwoyo
Ekuluma nnyo
Tolina mukwano,
Oli muyi.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Komaw(o) omutambuze
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ebibi byo byonna
Lekera ddala,
Gye ndi kye kitiibwa,
N'essanyu nnyo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Komaw(o) omutambuze
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Oluggi luggule,
Okyali wange,
Tojja kugobebwa,
Siikunyoome.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Komaw(o) omutambuze
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Byonna bye wakola,
Nnakusonyiwa,
Nnakusonyiwa,
Nnawaayo-obulamu
Ne mbiriwa.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Komaw(o) omutambuze
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

verse.name: v11
verse.lines:
Laba-emmeza yange
Etegekeddwa,
Jjangu naakuliisa
Nze-akwagala.

verse.name: v12
verse.lines:
Komaw(o) omutambuze
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.
